gifts.name: Main Stage

Canopy jobs: (1) **shelter dancers from sun**, (2) **protect LED + PA from sun and rain**, (3) buy time for **orderly teardown** if weather turns — rain still **cancels the festival day** (we are **not** renting a guest rain hall or planning a wet show). Includes dance deck as needed, ADA, **changing-room trailer(s)**, stay-put **LED** + lights, PA, generators. LED doubles as **Saturday Soul Torrent / Fashion backdrop** and **Sunday Tailgate watch** surface. Big Game **broadcast rights** stay a separate Tailgate gift. Confirm 40×60 + trailer quotes.

gifts.name: Weather / Cancel Fund
gifts.tagline: First-tranche reserve for a washed weekend — sunk ops only, not gift-registry spending.
gifts.description: **Self-insurance for weather cancel.** Mid-February outdoor weekends in the Sacramento region wet enough to cancel a park day are **common enough to plan for** — on the order of **~3 in 10 seasons** over the long run (not a single-weekend forecast). **2025** is the worked example: rain crushed turnout (**~80% attendance drop** vs 2024), and expensive cover tents did not save the day. Target cash held for a full-weekend cancel so we can absorb **non-refundable sunk core** (insurance/permit already paid, deposits, early installs) without raiding next year’s program. **Vendor booth fees are reversed from fees collected** (100% if both days cancel · 50% if one day) — refunds are a liquidity reverse, not an add-on to this fund. This **$8,000** is a **first tranche** (~one-third of a mid-case max wash); dry-year earned surplus and Great Lantern Festival surplus refill until the pot grows. **Not** available for High Priority or elective registry gifts.
benefits: Weather resilience sponsor recognition on website + email

lineItems.label: Weather / cancel reserve (first tranche toward ~$20–26K sunk-core target)

gifts.name: Moditional Dance Battle
gifts.tagline: Modern-meets-traditional crew battle — schools remix áo dài, lion, and fan with hip-hop and K-pop.
gifts.description: **Moditional Dance Battle** — a **judged, cross-school modern + traditional fusion crew competition**. **EGUSD high school** crews and cultural clubs compete head-to-head, but every routine must **fuse modern + traditional** (áo dài, lion, fan, or heritage movement remixed with hip-hop / K-pop / cover). Scoring blends a **light panel** with a **crowd-hype meter**, so the audience has a job. **Participation guardrail:** between rounds, a near-peer leader runs an **open-floor learn-along** (shared with the Meme Dance Contest mechanic) so little kids and families jump in — not a watch-only stage. **Medals + traveling title to crews, no individual crowning** — celebrates craft, not a pageant pedestal. **Pan-APIDA / multicultural** — open to all school clubs, not VN-only. Battle crews also supply the near-peer leaders for the Meme Dance Contest. **Separate from Tết Relay Cup** (grass athletics) and the **Meme Dance Contest** (under-12 follow-along). **EGUSD HS anchors** the bill; **college / Sac State crews welcome as guests** (same fusion rule — do not crowd out HS slots). Gen Z *audience* lane still assumed at Sac State when they launch. *(Successor to the 2026 Youth Culture Day stage showcase.)*
